_comment: Journey friction budgets (ADR 0074 pt 3 / ADR 0081 Q3), schema v2. Each journey has FOUR hard/ratcheted metrics — interactions, screenTransitions, modalOpens, contextLosses — evaluated by src/test/journeyMetrics.ts via tests/browser/helpers/journey.ts. Values are the FIRST MEASURED count rounded up by 1 (the ratchet FLOOR) and are the SAME across the whole Playwright viewport matrix unless a real narrow-pane flow genuinely needs MORE user actions on some project, recorded in that journey's byProject (never used to hide a common regression). A project that needs FEWER actions is simply absorbed by the shared floor. interactions must never exceed the documented ceilings in docs/ux-journeys.md (J1 15, J1b 8, J2 25, J3 12, J4 13, J5 6, J6 15, J7 20); screenTransitions/modalOpens/contextLosses have no separate ceiling doc yet — they are new with Q3 and start at their first-measured floor. assertBudget() reddens when a journey grows past its floor (a UX regression) and logs a tighten suggestion per metric when it shrinks well below it.
